about.description: Desi Tadka Indian Restaurant serves authentic Indian cuisine with a modern touch, blending traditional flavors and fresh ingredients for a memorable dining experience. Founded by seasoned individuals with 100 years in the food industry.

menu.name: Idli (3 pcs)
menu.description: Savory rice cakes made by steaming a batter of fermented lentils and rice. Served with chutneys and sambar.

menu.name: Ghee Podi Idli
menu.description: Soft idlis tossed in ghee and spicy podi (spiced lentil powder). Served with sambar and chutney.
